question: Gale & Cosm avocado oil who makes it
markdown:
Avocado oil associated with Gale & Cosm is made by
Gale & Cosm S.r.l.
, an Italian manufacturer and distributor based near Milan, Italy. They produce specialized raw materials and water-dispersible cosmetic ingredients (such as
Galeavocado® WS
) for the personal care and beauty industry.
